excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的范格利集团！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of The Vengralian Trium! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

label.zh: 我们打算买一个圣遗物。

label.en: We had something else in mind...
We had something else in mind...

label.zh: 我们打算买一个圣遗物。
我们想用能量购买一个圣遗物。
label.en: We will buy a Reliquary using energy.
We had something else in mind...

texts.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的范格利集团！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
texts.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of The Vengralian Trium! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

texts.zh: 行商联盟欢迎您光临绰尔的罗盘，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
texts.en: The Caravansary Caravan Coalition welcomes you to Chor's Compass, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

texts.zh: 欢迎来到贸易空间站堂吉，这里是全宇宙最顶级的休闲场所，同时也是行商舰队的家园！
texts.en: Welcome to Tradestation Tungle, the galaxy's premier leisure palace and home base of the Caravaneer fleets!

texts.zh:
根据心理档案资料显示对成瘾性活动抵抗力弱的智慧生命一般都不推荐参与老虎机和圣遗物活动。

如果他们那么不喜欢享乐的话，那就这样吧！
texts.en:
Sapients with psychological profiles particularly vulnerable to addictive activities are advised to stay away from the Slots and Reliquaries.

If they hate fun, that is!

texts.zh: 我们是绰尔的罗盘的行商联盟的范格利集团。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
texts.en: This is the Caravansary Caravan Coalition in Chor's Compass, speaking on behalf of The Vengralian Trium. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

texts.zh: 我们是绰尔的罗盘的行商联盟的拜金教团。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
texts.en: This is the Caravansary Caravan Coalition in Chor's Compass, speaking on behalf of The Numistic Order. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

texts.zh: 我们是绰尔的罗盘的行商联盟的拉奇工业公司。我们不会为贵方跟我方舰队此前的互动承担任何责任。
texts.en: This is the Caravansary Caravan Coalition in Chor's Compass, speaking on behalf of Racket Industrial Enterprise. We will not be held responsible for any previous interactions with the fleet.

texts.zh:
根据心理档案资料显示对成瘾性活动抵抗力弱的智慧生命一般都不推荐参与老虎机和圣遗物活动。

如果他们那么不喜欢享乐的话，那就这样吧！
texts.en:
Sapients with psychological profiles particularly vulnerable to addictive activities are advised to stay away from the Slots and Reliquaries.

If they hate fun, that is!

texts.zh: 你是会赌博的智慧生物吗？
texts.en: Are you a betting sapient?

texts.zh: 我们这买的大赚的大，当然如果你不是那种孤注一掷型选手，那我们这也提供下小注的业务。
texts.en: We offer high-stakes thrills and also low-stakes thrills, if that's more your speed.

label.zh: 我们是想联系范格利集团来着……
label.en: We were trying to reach The Vengralian Trium...

label.zh: 我们是想联系拜金教团来着……
label.en: We were trying to reach The Numistic Order...

label.zh: 我们是想联系拉奇来着……
label.en: We were trying to reach the Rackets...

texts.zh: 行商币是一种由行商货币委员会创造的高级货币。
texts.en: CaravanCoinz is a premium currency created by the Caravaneer Monetization Committee.

label.zh: 查看 行商币 账户

label.en: We had something else in mind...

texts.zh:
这个小游戏的目标是要在滚筒停止旋转时将滚筒上的图案排列为一行。

不，你没办法完全操纵它们什么时候停止。是不是有点小兴奋想马上试试？
texts.en:
The goal is to have the symbols on the spinning reels line up, when said reels eventually stop spinning.

No, you do not have any control over the timing of it all. Isn't that exciting?

texts.zh: 理论上来说，你有很高几率大赢特赢！
texts.en: You have a statistically extant chance to win big!

texts.zh: 这些转轴是使用这个太空站上的最后一批加图兽的骨髓做成的。那些害虫可难缠了。
texts.en: The reels get their pearlescent finish from the marrow of the last Gatunems to even haunt this station. Horrid little pests.

label.en: We had something else in mind...

texts.zh: 滚筒一个接着一个停了下来，结果是……
texts.en: One after another, the reels come to a halt, and...

texts.zh: 年代久远的圣遗物被放置在豪华的十字基座上。宝箱里一定存满了各种宝物。
texts.en: The ancient Reliquary rests on an opulent pedestal. It must surely be filled with untold riches.

label.zh: 我们打算买一个圣遗物。
我们想用能量购买一个圣遗物。
label.en: We will buy a Reliquary using energy.
We had something else in mind...

texts.zh: 好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的能量币会略有提升。
texts.en: Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only a nominal increase in Energy Credits each time.

texts.zh:
圣遗物是……空的。

你尽可能压抑心中的怨念不让心中的羞恼之意浮于面部。到底是因为湿度骤增还是因为你的眼睛不受控制的湿润了？你的目光模糊了，但是空无一物的圣遗物依旧在那安然不动。

但随着一阵存在主义的黑暗吞噬过后，一切都过去了。这是什么感觉？回想起在你花费掉辛苦挣来的行商币，缓缓打开圣遗物时那种发自内心的紧张与激动……你现在充满了一种说不清道不明的骄傲与成就感。
texts.en:
The Reliquary is... empty.

Bitter disappointment claws at your insides as you struggle to maintain your composure in the face of this chance humiliation. Did humidity levels suddenly rise or are your ocular organs moistening on their own? Your vision blurs, but the emptiness of the Reliquary still stands out in sharp relief.

But as soon as an existential darkness threatens to devour you, it is swept away. What is this feeling? As you mull over the hard-earned CaravanCoinz you spent, the visceral thrill of opening the Reliquary... you are filled with an inexplicable sense of pride and accomplishment.

texts.zh: 是银河之星……！
texts.en: The Galatron...!

texts.zh: 圣遗物包含着一副远古图表，写满了早已失传的贸易路线，其中还包括了我们的首都恒星系[Root.Capital.GetStarName]！
texts.en: The Reliquary contains an ancient chart over long-dead trade routes, and it includes our capital system of [Root.Capital.GetStarName]!

texts.zh:
圣遗物里存放着一整套的制服。可惜的是，这些衣服的设计对象是某种比[Root.GetName]的物种更多肢体的生物。

不过，这些衣服的质料还是可以循环利用的。
texts.en:
The Reliquary contains a full complement of dress uniforms. Unfortunately they were designed for a species with far more limbs than is common within the [Root.GetName].

The material might still be re-purposed, however.

texts.zh:
圣遗物里有炸弹！

别担心，已经拆掉了。
texts.en:
The Reliquary contains a bomb!

It is swiftly defused.

texts.zh: 圣遗物装着一篇关于爱与万物自然循环的论文。它由[Root.GetAdj]语言写成，而且文风十分现代。
texts.en: The Reliquary contains a treatise on love, and the cyclical nature of all things. It is written in the [Root.GetAdj] language and the style is contemporary.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里存放着一把未知来历的枪械，其发射扳机明显已被破坏掉。
texts.en: The Reliquary contains a gun of unknown origin, with the apparent trigger assembly removed.

texts.zh: 圣遗物装着满满的军粮。虽然上面的所有标记都已经磨损殆尽了，但是里面的东西看起来尚且安全，而且适合[Root.GetAdj]的生理结构。
texts.en: The Reliquary contains a shipment of military rations. All markings on the packaging have worn off, but the contents appear safe and compatible with [Root.GetAdj] biology.

texts.zh:
圣遗物里面放着音乐，虽然这盒子里并没有任何显而易见的类似播放器的东西。

圣遗物马上被关上，并且被遗忘在某个角落里面
texts.en:
The Reliquary contains music, without any obvious playback mechanism.

The Reliquary is soon closed and forgotten about.

texts.zh: 圣遗物装满了美丽的蓝色大理石。
texts.en: The Reliquary is filled with beautiful blue marbles.

texts.zh:
圣遗物里面装着数不清的财富，如果你对不在场的人说起的话，没有人会相信这么巨量的财富会真实存在。

不过财务报表上的赤字正宣告着这个事实。
texts.en:
The Reliquary is filled with untold riches. Indeed, no one present at the opening is capable of accurately describing the immense wealth, if they will even acknowledge its existence at all.

But the treasury's balance sheet spells it out clearly enough.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里面装着几个外星设备，看上去没什么反应，应该是坏了的。
texts.en: The Reliquary holds a handful of alien devices, inert and seemingly broken.

texts.zh: 虽然是空的，但是这个圣遗物的内壁上到底都是各种印记。在更深处的地方追踪到了一些生物物质的踪迹。
texts.en: While empty, the inner walls of the Reliquary are pitted and scarred. Traces of biological material can be recovered from the deeper pockets.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里存放着一个只能以波频的方式存在于空灵界面的生灵。它在被发现后瞬间逃离到更高阶的位面，只在你心里留下深刻的启示与不安。
texts.en: The Reliquary holds a being that exists only as a spectrum of wavelengths in an ethereal medium. It immediately escapes to a higher domain, leaving only profound revelation and paralytic fear in its wake.

texts.zh: 圣遗物很难打开，感觉里面似乎是有一个小型的重力井阻止它打开似的。
texts.en: The Reliquary is difficult to open, as it is shut tight from within by a gravitational anomaly.

texts.zh: 圣遗物里面什么都没有。原本用于贮藏的空间被一块平滑的合金占据了，与圣遗物的内壁无缝地衔接在一起。
texts.en: The Reliquary does not contain anything. Where one would expect hollow space for storage sits instead a smooth block of metal alloy, one interior wall of the Reliquary blending seamlessly into another.

texts.zh: 银河之星归你了！
texts.en: The Galatron is yours!

label.en: What is it worth? Can it be sold?

texts.zh: 我们得知范格利集团已经立即关闭了其移动门市，因为该行商已被彻底消灭了。
texts.en: We have received word that The Vengralian Trium is shuttering its mobile storefront effective immediately, due to the caravan being utterly annihilated.

texts.zh:
在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告财富之风已被摧毁。

曾经名噪一时的拉奇行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
texts.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Winds of Fortune has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be troubled by their sanctimonious presence no more.

texts.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说财富之风已被歼灭。

在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的拜金教商人行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。

对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。
texts.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the Winds of Fortune is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling Merchant of Numa caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard.

An unfortunate end for those serving the goddess of fortune herself.

texts.zh:
关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们拉奇工业公司已经被摧毁了。

曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。
texts.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Racket Industrial Enterprise has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap. We shall be troubled by their clattering presence no more.

title.zh: 拉奇工业公司已被摧毁

texts.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，拉奇工业公司已经不复存在了。

在与[From.GetName]发生冲突之后，曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。

希望这样的结果会令他们感到满意。
texts.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the Racket Industrial Enterprise is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap.

Perhaps it is an end that would not have displeased them.
